## formal
In the three-argument functional of Proposition \claimref{dark-energy.point-infinity-has-no-physical-fluctuation}, $\Lambda$ enters as the value of the Stelle-West constraints $Q(I) = \Lambda/3$, $Q(V) = -3/\Lambda$, a number fixed before variation: it is the index $\mu$ of Definition \claimref{obj.dark-energy.four-ways-number-enters-theory-shape}. Consequently:
\begin{enumerate}
\item[(i)] with $\Lambda$ fixed, the constrained fluctuation space of $(I, V)$ has dimension nine and the nine broken generators act onto it bijectively (Proposition \claimref{dark-energy.point-infinity-has-no-physical-fluctuation}): no fluctuation of the norm exists, every solution with parameter $\Lambda$ has $H^2 = Q(I) = \Lambda/3$ on its de Sitter region, and $N = M_P/H$ is constant on each $\mathcal{S}_\Lambda$;
\item[(ii)] $N$ varies with $\Lambda$ across the family, $d(N^2)/d\Lambda = -3M_P^2/\Lambda^2 \neq 0$, so it is not (D); and it is not (K), by the rescaling argument of Fact \claimref{standard-model.trichotomy-what-kind-number};
\item[(iii)] therefore $N$ is (P), a parameter of the laws, and not (I): clause (3) of the Standard-Model paper's classification, ``$N$ is initial data'', is false for the action as written.
\end{enumerate}
If instead $\Lambda$ is allowed to vary, the linearised constraints become three independent conditions on the thirteen components $(\delta I, \delta V, \delta\Lambda)$, the constrained space has dimension ten, the gauge orbit is still nine-dimensional (bivectors do not change a norm), and exactly one non-gauge direction appears: the norm mode
\[
(\delta I, \delta V, \delta\Lambda) \;\propto\; \Bigl(\frac{I}{2\Lambda},\ -\frac{V}{2\Lambda},\ 1\Bigr),
\]
which is the tangent at $s = 1$ of the rescaling family $(sI, V/s, s^2\Lambda)$ and which needs an equation of motion the action does not supply.

## technical
In the three-argument functional, $\Lambda$ enters as the value of the Stelle-West constraints $Q(I) = \Lambda/3$, $Q(V) = -3/\Lambda$, a number fixed before variation, so it is the index $\mu$ of the four-way classification. With $\Lambda$ fixed, the pure-gauge count leaves no fluctuation of the norm, and $N = M_P/H$, with $\Lambda = 3H^{2}$, is constant on each solution space $\mathcal{S}_\Lambda$. It varies across the family, $d(N^2)/d\Lambda = -3M_P^2/\Lambda^2\neq 0$, so it is not dynamically fixed, and by the rescaling argument it is not kinematic; by exhaustiveness it is a parameter of the laws and not initial data, for the action as written.

If $\Lambda$ is allowed to vary, the constrained space of $(\delta I,\delta V,\delta\Lambda)$ has dimension ten against a nine-dimensional gauge orbit, leaving one non-gauge norm mode, $(\delta I,\delta V,\delta\Lambda) \propto (I/2\Lambda, -V/2\Lambda, 1)$, the tangent of the rescaling family $(sI, V/s, s^2\Lambda)$; it needs an equation of motion that the action does not supply.

## lay
The cosmological constant fixes the length of the frozen point. Under the action exactly as written, this length cannot fluctuate within any one solution, yet it differs between theories with different cosmological constants. That makes it a setting of the laws rather than initial data chosen for each universe. Making it initial data would need an extra equation of motion that the action does not provide.

## one-liner
Under the action as written, $N = M_P/H$ ($\Lambda = 3H^{2}$) is constant on each solution space and varies with $\Lambda$, so it is a parameter of the laws and not initial data.

proofs.proof-main.tex: (i) is Proposition \claimref{dark-energy.point-infinity-has-no-physical-fluctuation}'s count read as a statement about the norm: the three linearised constraints are independent because $I$ and $V$ are non-null and orthogonal, the constrained space is $12 - 3 = 9$, and every constrained fluctuation is a gauge transformation, so the norm cannot fluctuate; that $H^2 = Q(I) = \Lambda/3$ on the de Sitter region is Fact \claimref{dark-energy.imported-frozen-point-geometry}'s norm with Theorem \claimref{dark-energy.frozen-point-makes-stelle-west-vector}'s identification of it as the Stelle-West value. (ii): the script verifies $d(N^2)/d\Lambda = -3M_P^2/\Lambda^2$ as an identity of rational functions in $\Lambda$ and evaluates $N^2$ at two rational values of $\Lambda$ to unequal values; the rescaling clause is Fact \claimref{standard-model.trichotomy-what-kind-number}: $\Lambda \to s^2\Lambda$ with the conformal class unchanged changes $N$ and not the kinematic isomorphism class, so $N$ does not factor through that class. (iii) is Proposition \claimref{dark-energy.four-alternatives-are-exhaustive-three-are}. The free case: the linearised constraints acquire the columns $-\tfrac13\,\delta\Lambda$ and $-(3/\Lambda^2)\,\delta\Lambda$ in the first and third rows; the script, at the same rational instance Proposition \claimref{dark-energy.point-infinity-has-no-physical-fluctuation}'s checks use, computes rank three on thirteen variables, rank nine of the fifteen gauge images extended by a zero $\delta\Lambda$-component, rank ten of those images together with the displayed norm mode (so the mode is not a gauge direction and spans the complement), and checks that the norm mode satisfies the free constraints, violates the fixed ones, and equals $1/(2\Lambda)$ times the $s$-derivative of $(sI, V/s, s^2\Lambda)$ at $s = 1$, the derivative taken componentwise on the family as a vector of rational functions in a formal $s$, whose members satisfy the constraints at $s^2\Lambda$ as identities in $s$.
